infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: TrailForge uses your location to show nearby trails on the map and to record your rides.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: TrailForge needs background location so it can keep recording your ride when the screen is locked.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: TrailForge keeps recording your ride in the background so you don't have to keep the app open.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: TrailForge needs access to your photos so you can attach trail photos.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: TrailForge needs the camera to capture trail photos.
